# Skopli

> An open-source SDK (MIT) that reads the session logs of 40 coding-agent harnesses from local disk, rolls them up, and prices them against market catalogs. One Rust core serves 9 languages under the MIT license, with no account and no telemetry.

Read and Rollup never touch the network. Price fetches OpenRouter, LiteLLM, and models.dev catalogs by default, caches them, and works offline from the cache. An unmatched model returns `priced: false` with the keys it tried instead of a guessed rate.

## Links

- [Documentation](https://docs.skopli.com/skopli/): guides and reference. Every page has a Markdown twin (append .md), and the site serves /skopli/llms.txt and /skopli/llms-full.txt.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/skopli/skopli): source and issues.
